theorem_statement: Theorem (determinantal rank-drop ideals and fibre dimensions at (g,n)=(6,6)). Let pi:C->S be a smooth proper family of genus-6 curves over a locally noetherian characteristic-zero base S, with a relative effective Cartier divisor Gamma finite locally free of degree 6, carrying a balanced tetragonal Casnati-Ekedahl structure with summands W_4, W_5 (fibre degrees deg(W_4)=20, deg(W_5)=16). Then: (i) R^1 pi_* W_f = 0 for f=4,5; pi_*W_4 and pi_*W_5 are vector bundles of ranks 15 and 11 whose formation commutes with arbitrary base change; pi_*(W_f|_Gamma) is locally free of rank 6; the combined evaluation phi = phi_4 + phi_5 is a map of locally free sheaves of ranks 26 -> 12 and Fit_0(coker phi) = I_12(phi), the ideal of 12x12 minors. (ii) At every geometric point of S, and over every open on which W splits as W_4 + W_5, I_12(phi) = I_6(phi_4)*I_6(phi_5); phi_4 is fibrewise surjective (the Serre dual of its cokernel has degree -4), hence I_6(phi_4) = O_S and I_12(phi) = I_6(phi_5). No global splitting over the universal balanced base is asserted. (iii) Formation of I_6(phi_5) commutes with arbitrary base change; phi_5 is, up to twisting by a line bundle pulled back from the base (which does not change Fitting/maximal-minor ideals), the underived pullback along a_N:S->Pic^0(C/S) of the universal evaluation Phi of L_univ (relative degree 16, R^1 p_* L_univ = 0, rank p_* L_univ = 11). (iv) On a geometric fibre C_s, the zero set of I_6(phi_5) in Sym^6(C_s) is exactly {Gamma : O(Gamma) ~= L_s := W_5 tensor omega^{-1}}, i.e. the Abel-Jacobi fibre |L_s| ~= P^{h^0(L_s)-1}; on the balanced locus with fibre divisor D_s one has L_s ~= omega(-D_s), so the failure condition is D_s + Gamma canonical. Equality with the Abel-Jacobi incidence is asserted only on geometric points/reductions ((Z_ev)_red = I_red, dependency C66-GEO-Z / ATT-0048); no scheme-theoretic equality is claimed. (v) 1 <= h^0(L_s) <= 4; precisely h^0(L_s) = 1 + h^0(M_s) with M_s := omega^2 tensor W_5^dual of degree 4, and h^0(M_s) <= 3 by Clifford whenever h^0(M_s) >= 1; hence dim Z_ev(C_s) = h^0(L_s)-1 lies in {0,1,2,3}. Moreover h^0(L_s) = 4 only if C_s is hyperelliptic and M_s = 2g^1_2. The reduced-support/ordered sublocus is open in |L_s| and may be empty; chi(L_s)=1 does not imply its nonemptiness. (vi) Expected-codimension bookkeeping only: the expected codimension of {rk phi_5 <= 5} for ranks 11 -> 6 is (11-5)(6-5) = 6 inside the relative Sym^6 (fibre dimension 6), agreeing with the pinned 3*2 = 6 computation; the source count 15 + (h^0(L_s)-1) <= 18 (equal to 17 if h^0(L_s)=3, giving naive codimension 4 in the 21-dimensional M_{6,6}) is recorded strictly as a source dimension, and no conclusion about image dimension, generic fibre dimension, or component purity in M_{6,6} is drawn.
